about: Stage 3 clip picks for scene E (2026-10-22 autonomous run). Frame id -> chosen file (relative to media unless a full path is given), in/out seconds inside that file, and what stage 4 needs. Every take, prompt and credit is in shots.md; the spend is in scripts/gpom/second-half-video/ending/ledger.json (scene 'E').
engine: Omni 1.1 Flash, Frames (start frame only), 16:9, 720p, x1; 1280x720 24 fps; clips carry Omni's own audio (mute on the timeline)

E01.post: composite D16's last frame onto the phone screen (track the phone, a little soft, screen glow); phone audio = Maddie's '...you go.' (e1-0-maddie-phone.wav) landing on the hard cut
E01.note: The phone in the plate shows a delivery robot in ruins: it must be covered by the composite. The window light pulses warm/cold through the clip (passing street lights).

E02.alt: E02-t1.mp4 0-4.0 (the bus moves off at ~4 s and the bank slides out of the window)
E02.post: composite D16's frame (dimmed) onto the phone 0-2.8 s, then the phone drops out of shot; Omni brightens the screen to near white at ~2 s, so the composite must cover it (never a white screen)
E02.note: Review round 1 re-roll: the phone stays in her hand, lowered to her knee. Looks up ~1.5 s, turns to the bank ~3 s, holds to the end. Screen white from ~1 s (composite covers it until she tilts it away at 2.5 s). Street and window locked (shopfront breathes ~1.5 px). Bank lettered in post (bank_sign.py).
E02.was: E02-t2.mp4 (review round 1: the phone melted into her lap at ~2.8 s)

chain: E03bx-t1.mp4 (from E03b-t1's last frame, first frame dropped; 0.3 s dissolve at 9.71 s)
E03.post: bank_sign_e03.py (DOWNLAND BANK + closure sheet, tracked; 'Bank Bank' wiped off the shop next door), regrade, pull-back 140% -> 100% eased 1.5-9.5 s, the last line, fade to black
E03.note: Review round 2: E03f-r1-b edited so the betting shop beside the pharmacy is E02's whitewashed closed bank (blank fascia, black door), re-animated and extended (27 credits). Camera locked but drifts ~44 px over 17 s (followed by the lettering). The bus reaches mid-distance; the hooded walkers turn away in the extension.
E03.was: E03f-chain.mp4 (review round 2: the bank E02 set up was a lit betting shop here)

E04.post: 3 s black under the e-coda tail
